senses.definition: n.pr.loc. (place of street, or market?) near Dan on road to Hamath Ju 18:28; 2 S 10:6 (where אֲרַם בֵּית־רְחוֹב) = רְחֹב Nu 13:21; cf. אֲרַם צוֹבָא וּרְחוֹב 2 S 10:8;—loc. dub. (cf. Robiii. 371 f.).
